address: 55/17 Mu 7, Khlong Suan Phlu, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: The story of Vietnamese food in Ayutthaya started over 150 years ago with the Vietnamese community in Bang Sai District. It continues at this modern two-floor restaurant smartly decorated with wooden walls, colourful paintings and a stylish bar. The menu may be short but it’s packed with authentic Vietnamese dishes. The skilled chef prepares everything using fresh quality ingredients. The signature dish, Nem Nuong is a delight to assemble and eat....
